blocks.arabic_text: رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي آخِرِ صَلَاتِهِ يُشِيرُ بِإِصْبَعِهِ السَّبَّابَةِ، وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَقُولُونَ يَسْحَرُبِهَا، وَكَذَبُوا وَلكِنَّهُ التَّوْحِيدُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد مطولا والطبراني في الكبير ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٣٣٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Khuffaf ibn Ima (RA) says, “When the Prophet ﷺ sat at the end of the Salah (in the final sitting), he would point with his index finger. On seeing this, the mushrikin kept saying, “He is doing magic with this pointing; (may Allah protect us) they were only telling lies. Rather, by this the Prophet ﷺ was indicating the Oneness of Allah” (this gesture conveys that Allah is One).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ نَافِعٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ قَالَ: كَانَ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ ﵄ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَي رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ وَأَتْبَعَهَا بَصَرَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَهِيَ أَشَدُّ عَلَي الشَّيْطَانِ مِنَ الْحَدِيدِ يَعْنِي السَّبَّابَةَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Nafi' (RH) says, “When Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) sat for at-Tahiyyat in Salah, he would place both his hands on his two knees, and while pointing with his (index) finger, he would fix his gaze on that finger. After praying, he said that the Prophet ﷺ said, “In the state of Tashahhud, the index finger is harder on Shaytan than iron”. (Indicating the Oneness of Allah with the index finger in the Tashahhud sitting is harder on Shaytan than being struck with things such as spears.
